arabic text: AAJ BHI ZAINAB KI AATI HAI SADA BHAI HUSSAIN\nTERA CHEHRA, TERI ANKHAIN, BHOL KAB PAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: EVEN TILL THIS DAY, THE CRIES OF ZAINAB (A.S) CAN BE HEARD, CALLING OUT TO HER BROTHER, O HUSSAIN (A.S)\n'WHEN HAVE I BEEN ABLE TO FORGET YOUR FACE AND EYES, O HUSSAIN (A.S)?'

arabic text: CHALTE NAAQE SE GIRAYA KHUD KO JALTI RAYT PAR\nGHUTNIYO KE BAL MAI TERI LAASH TAK AAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: I MADE MYSELF FALL FROM A MOVING CAMEL ONTO THE HOT SAND,\nI CAME TO YOUR BODY WHILE CRAWLING ON MY KNEES

arabic text: BUS MAY GHABRAYI THI KHANJAR TUJH PAY CHALTA DEKH KAR\nPHIR KISI MUSHKIL MAY GHIR KAR MAIN NA GHABRAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: 'I WAS ONLY PETRIFIED WHEN I SAW THE DAGGER SLIT YOUR THROAT…\nAFTER THAT, NO CALAMITY WOULD FRIGHTEN ME, O HUSSAIN (A.S)'

arabic text: KAUN THA JO MARNE WALON MAY NAHI THA KHUBARU\nBHOOLNE BAITHI TO KIS KIS KI NA YAAD AAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: ALL OF THE MARTYRS WERE BRAVE AND LOYAL,\nI AM UNABLE TO FORGET ANY OF THEM O HUSSAIN!

arabic text: BEH RAHE THAY AANKH SE AANSU TERI RUQSAT KE WAQT\nPHIR KOI AANSU NA TAPKA AANKH PATHRAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: TEARS WERE FLOWING FROM MY EYES AT THE TIME YOU DEPARTED,\nAFTER THAT NOT A SINGLE TEAR FELL FROM MY EYE

arabic text: DEKHTI HOON KHAAKE MAQTAL KI TO BHAR ATA HAI DIL\nKHAAK PAR MEIN KAISE KAISE PHOOL CHOR AAEE HUSSAIN
english translation text: 'MY HEART BECOMES HEAVY AS SOON AS I LOOK TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD…\nHOW MANY KINDS OF PRECIOUS FLOWERS HAVE I LEFT BEHIND, O HUSSAIN (A.S)?'

arabic text: DOOR UFTADA SAFAR SAY LOUT KAR MAY NAY NAVEED\nTHANDA PAANI JAB PIYA BAS TERI YAAD AI HUSSAIN
english translation text: 'WHEN I RETURNED FROM THE FOREIGN LAND…\nAS SOON AS I SIPPED A CUP OF COLD WATER, I ONLY REMEMBERED YOU O HUSSAIN (A.S)'
